## Authority Engine + one-command CLI

`v0.2.0` turns govern-project-docs from a reusable script collection into an installable command-line tool while preserving every existing direct-script workflow.

### Highlights

- Run directly from GitHub with `npx github:CH-ZHOU-0512/govern-project-docs`.
- Initialize a repository atomically with starter policies, schema v2, runtime checks, and a generated document index.
- Audit documentation without modifying the target repository.
- Enforce unique active authority claims, stable `doc-id` values, reciprocal supersession edges, and cycle-free replacement history.
- Continue using schema v1 configurations during incremental migration.

### Try it

```bash
npx github:CH-ZHOU-0512/govern-project-docs audit --repo .
npx github:CH-ZHOU-0512/govern-project-docs init --repo . --owner engineering
npx github:CH-ZHOU-0512/govern-project-docs check --repo .
```

The attached `govern-project-docs-0.2.0.tgz` is the exact npm-compatible package produced and validated by the release workflow.

See the [changelog](https://github.com/CH-ZHOU-0512/govern-project-docs/blob/v0.2.0/CHANGELOG.md) and [migration guide](https://github.com/CH-ZHOU-0512/govern-project-docs/blob/v0.2.0/references/migration-and-authority.md) for details.
